rule: Readiness joint flag after a region rated >= joint_flag_rating on 2 consecutive check-ins (clears after 2 consecutive <= 2)
summary: Same logic as the region flag: repeated self-reported regional problems are informative (Clarsen 2013; Saw 2016), and two days filters one-off soreness. Symmetric 2-day clearing is a heuristic. No study tests the number.

sources.note: OSTRC weekly questionnaire (knee/low back/shoulder): repeated self-report captures far more overuse problems than time-loss reporting
Saw 2016 SR (56 studies): subjective self-report measures track training load more sensitively than objective markers
